summary: CityPulse iteration 4 — frontend-only review of keyboard ergonomics + animations on the Expo web preview (390x844, seeded session test_session_citypulse). Verified: René is the default tab, 5 tabs render (tab-rene/tab-discover/tab-deals/tab-planner/tab-profile) with no overflow. Focus rene-input then tap on rene-chat-background (upper empty area) → activeElement becomes rene-chat-background (input blurred). Focus rene-input then drag/scroll inside the chat area → input blurred (keyboardDismissMode='on-drag' works on web). Quick actions still tappable inside the chat background wrapper: rene-quick-pluie tap triggers chat-typing (sending state). Greeting place strip tappable: rene-greeting-place-* opens /place/{slug} (verified musee-beaux-arts) and back navigation returns to /. Budget sheet opens via rene-budget-pill and rene-budget-30 is tappable, sheet closes. Tab-switching between the 5 tabs renders without blank screen (bodies: discover 4426, deals 5704, planner 6094, profile 6483 chars). Discover first place card opens place detail and back button returns to /discover. Planner shows planner-generate-button. Account shows profile stats + profile-journal-row (Carnet entry point). ONE WEB-SPECIFIC LIMITATION: pressing Enter inside rene-input does NOT trigger onSubmitEditing (no chat-user-* bubble, no chat-typing, activeElement stays rene-input). Root cause: multiline TextInput renders as <textarea> on react-native-web and Enter inserts a newline instead of firing onSubmitEditing even with returnKeyType='send' and submitBehavior='blurAndSubmit' (those are native-only). Native platforms will behave as specified (iOS/Android send on Enter + blur). On web the composer still works via the rene-send-button tap. Pre-existing benign RNW warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' persists (reanimated internal). No red screens, no React errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Enter key does not send the message on the web preview because multiline TextInput renders as <textarea> in react-native-web; onSubmitEditing is not fired. On native (iOS/Android) returnKeyType='send' + submitBehavior='blurAndSubmit' will work as specified. If the user wants web parity, add a web-only onKeyPress handler on rene-input: if e.nativeEvent.key==='Enter' && !e.shiftKey → preventDefault + call send(text) when non-empty, else Keyboard.dismiss(). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:168-181

rca_of_issue: On web preview Enter inside rene-input does not send the message. RCA: react-native-web renders <TextInput multiline={true}> as a <textarea>; onSubmitEditing is only emitted when the native Return key fires 'submit', which textarea does not do on Enter (Enter inserts a newline). The returnKeyType='send' and submitBehavior='blurAndSubmit' props are respected only by native iOS/Android. Mitigation: add a web-only onKeyPress handler that intercepts Enter without Shift, calls preventDefault, and invokes send(text) or Keyboard.dismiss() when empty. Native builds are unaffected and will behave per spec.
